Students' Book Emporium RINGREY, TURA West Garo Hills, Meghalaya Printed at : North-East Printing Press, South Sarania Ulubari, Guwahati-7 --- Page 7 --- Aganchengani Raja Abong Nogani gimin A-chik ja-delarangni ku-siko ku-akmachi aganako knaana agreba, K.
Mominni " Assam aro Meghalayani Katta" (Jak-145) minggipa ki-tapo, Abong Nogani gimin adita agananirangko nikna man-a.
Barkatakini tom·chimonggipa "Tribal Folktales of Assam(Hills)"minggipa ki-tapo D.
Rongmithuni “RajaAbong Noga and His Queen" (Jak-184) ine skotong done segipa jako Raja Abong Noga aro Rani Silme Do-kani gimin agananiko adita nikna man-a.
Kosako mesokbagipa ki-taprango pangchakean Dakmesokaniko sena jotton ka:oba, chanchie ra:anikoba jakkalna nangaiaha.
Maina, ua kitaprangoba chugimik ma:ambiko seaniko nikna man ja.
Ia Dakmesokaniko poraie nie saoba maiba on:dapna anga bilongen kusi ong begen.
Na-simangni ku'pattianiko aro agandapaniko knana ske nisoenggipa ..
Sangma FCI, District Office, Upper Lachumiere, Shillong-1.
Ua bang'a songsarni golporangko, Dakmesokaniko aro seatang poedorangko tomchimonggiminko chapa ka-atmanaha.
Anching A chikrang Abong Noga, uni jikgipa Silme Do-kani aro Abong Nogani neng'rak neng'takatgija mi olruragiparangni mi pakdape siatgipa Abong Nogani demechik Mejeni gimin bang'ede u-ija.
Uamangni bidingo sandimanchae tale roke seani dongjani gimin, an.chingni uamangni gimin u-iania chong-diksasan ong'aia.
Ia “Abong Noga" Dakmesokanini senokgipaba uni Aganchenganio iako janapa.
Mominni "Assam aro Meghalayani Katta"-oniko ontisa aro S.N.

Barkatakini Dewansing Rongmuthuni segipa “Raja Abong Noga and His Queen"-oniko adita uie ra-aniko man-aha ineba janapa, indiba chu-gimikgipa Dakmesokaniko sena, gisiktango chanchiataniko, gisiko nikataniko jakkalchapna nangaha ine senokgipa uni aganchenganio janapa.
Indake ia Dakmesokani, gipinrangni seanirang gitan, ong:chongmota paksa, banaidapa pil-sa ong'a.
Uni gimin, iade A-chik Ma'ambini gita ongja ine jeani dongja.
Dakmesokaniko seani Songsarni Golpoko seaoni dingtanga aro altujabata.
Golpoo je somoioba jechiba re-ate, je biapoba golponi obostako ongate sena man'a.
Dakmesokaniode golpoo gita meliate donaina man ja.
Sal somoi aro ong:chakgipa biap melitelna, ma kete re-na nanga.
Golpoo jegita ro-eba aganaia; uagita Dakmesokaniode ong:ja.
Dakmesokaniode, katta te-rake, tokkame donosa, kal-enggiparangna agantoa, gisik ra na altua.
Ia pilakkon chanchie, senokgipa "Raja Abong Noga"-ko seaha.
(ii) --- Page 9 --- Raja Abong Noga mande namjabeoba, bon-kamao una on'tisa ka'pakani gisikko senokgipa nakatata.
Bang-bata seanirangko dakangkue, A chikku Sea-Jotanina gamchatgipa ongilaniko dakangkuchina, anga senokgipa Prabodh M.
Sangmana Nama skanirangko on'na kusi ong bea.
Director, DERT President, A·chik Literature Society, Tura.
